title: From Native Memes to Global Moderation: Cross-Cultural Evaluation of Vision–Language Models for Hateful Meme Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful memes containing region-specific religious symbolism as part of a broader cross-cultural evaluation.
findings: The study evaluated model performance on an Arabic dataset (Prop2Hate) that includes memes with region-specific religious symbolism. The general finding is that models struggle with culturally nuanced content, including religious contexts, and that common 'translate-then-detect' approaches degrade performance, while native-language prompting and culturally aligned examples improve it.
